name: Corn Term Structure Dashboard
description: Corn (ZC) forward curve and term structure dashboard. Shows current carry (M1/M2 - 1) and M1-M2 calendar spread, contango vs backwardation regime frequency over the full period, rolling carry history with 20d MA, and seasonal carry pattern by calendar month. Uses NoAdjustment continuation with spread_depth=1.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN (ZC) FORWARD CURVE / TERM STRUCTURE DASHBOARD
# =============================================================================
#
# Analyzes ZC corn futures term structure using built-in carry and spread signals.
#
# NoAdjustment preserves real price levels for spread/carry computation.
# cont.carry = M1/M2 - 1 (positive = backwardation, negative = contango)
# cont.spread = M1 - M2 via spread_depth=1 (positive = backwardation)
#
# Outputs:
#   1. Summary snapshot: current carry, M1-M2 spread, contango/backwardation %
#   2. Line chart: rolling carry over time with zero reference line
#   3. Bar chart: average carry by calendar month (seasonal pattern)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: ZC (Corn) with NoAdjustment + term structure ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

zc_carry = cont.carry
zc_spread = cont.spread

# --- Carry smoothing ---
carry_ma20 = ma(period=20)(zc_carry)

# --- Contango/Backwardation frequency flags ---
# carry < 0 = contango (front < deferred)
# carry > 0 = backwardation (front > deferred)
is_contango = where(zc_carry < 0, 1, 0)
is_backwardation = where(zc_carry > 0, 1, 0)

# --- Calendar month for seasonal analysis ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Term Structure Snapshot
# Current carry as %, current M1-M2 spread in $/bu,
# % of days in contango and backwardation over the full period
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Corn Term Structure Snapshot',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Current Levels', 'Regime Frequency'],
        col_headers=['Carry / Contango', 'Spread / Backwardation'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(info='Current Carry (M1/M2 - 1)', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Current M1-M2 Spread ($/bu)', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='% Days in Contango (carry < 0)', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='% Days in Backwardation (carry > 0)', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Snapshot'
)(zc_carry, zc_spread, is_contango, is_backwardation)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Rolling Carry Over Time
# Shows carry signal history with 20d MA and zero reference line
# Positive = backwardation (front premium), Negative = contango (front discount)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Corn Carry: Front/Back - 1 (Backwardation > 0, Contango < 0)',
    category='2. Carry History',
    y_axis_label='Carry',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zc_carry, carry_ma20))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Seasonal Carry by Calendar Month
# Average carry per month reveals seasonal contango/backwardation patterns
# (e.g., new-crop vs old-crop dynamics around harvest months)
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Average Carry by Calendar Month',
    category='3. Seasonal Pattern',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Avg Carry',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_labels=True,
    order=2
)(values=zc_carry, label=month_num)
